page.notes: Running head absent on this page. No page number printed; "D 2" at foot is the gathering signature. Doubtful readings: the Hebrew in the first line (הזרעים) and the Greek words after "ἀναμφιλέκτως" and before "is qui ad" (ὁ στρατολόγος, ἀθλοθέτης, θριαμβευτὴς, τροπαιοῦχος, Νικοποιὸς) are hard to read at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. The Hebrew על in "quia videlicet על" is also uncertain. "patebuntq;" is read as a single word with q; abbreviation. The marginal note is in a smaller type and is set on three to five lines with a printed hyphen "con-servanda".
